name: @w6w-apps/inoreader
description: Read and manage an Inoreader account: subscriptions, folders and tags, unread counts, stream contents and item ids, read/starred state.

w6w.longDescription: Inoreader is an RSS and news reader. Its developer API (a Google-Reader-compatible surface at www.inoreader.com/reader/api/0) lets a workflow list a user's subscriptions, folders and tags, read unread counts, pull article streams and item ids, follow or unfollow feeds, and change article state (read, starred, custom tags). Connect a user's account through OAuth 2.0 with an Inoreader developer application. The API is only available to paid (Pro and above) plans, and is metered in two daily zones: zone 1 for reads and zone 2 for writes.
